chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin si-le-sa deihna bangin kalsuan loin Kha deih bangin a kalsuan, Khazih sungah a om mite in mawhna thukhenna tawh a kipelh zo uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih Zeisu hanga a om nuntakna’ Kha tawh kipawl thukham in mawhna leh sihna’ thukham sung pan kei hong honkhia zo hi.
Thukham in i ci i sa hangin a thanem ahih ciangin a kibawl zo lo nate, Pasian in mawhna tawh a dim pumpi lim bangin a Tapa mawhna maisak dingin hong sawlin, ci leh sa sungah mawhna a hong khen hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ci leh sa deihna zui loin Pasian’ Kha Siangtho’ deihna zui-in a nungta eite tungah a Thukham hanciamna thu a tun’ nading hi.
Ci leh sa a zuite in ci leh sa’ thu a ngai uh hi. Pasian’ Kha Siangtho a zuite in Pasian’ Kha Siangtho’ thu a ngai uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ci leh sa lungsim in sihna tawh kituak hi. Kha Siangtho lungsim in nuntakna leh nopna tawh kituak hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ci leh sa lungsim in Pasian’ Thukham mang lo tham loin a mang zo lo ahih maninah Pasian tawh a kido hi.
Ci leh sa sungah a omte in Pasian a lungdamsak zo kei uh hi.

Pasian’ Kha Siangtho in note sungah a teen’ leh, note in ci leh sa sungah na om kei uh hi; Pasian’ Kha Siangtho sungah na om uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih’ Kha Siangtho a nei lo mite in Khazih’ mi ahi kei uh hi.
Khazih in note sungah a om leh, na pumpi un mawhna hangin a sih hangin na kha un dikna hangah a nungta hi.
Zeisu a thokiksak Pasian’ Kha Siangtho in note sungah a om leh, Khazih Zeisu a thokik sakpa in, note sungah a teeng a Kha Siangtho hangin, a si thei na pumpi uh zong hin’na a pia ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ute naute aw, eite in ci leh sa thu zuih nadingin, ci sa lei i ba kei hi.
Note in ci leh sa thu zui-in na nuntak uh leh, na si ding uh hi. Kha Siangtho hangin na pumpi uh a gamtatna na sihsak uh leh, na nungta ding uh hi.
Pasian’ Kha Siangtho’ thuhilhna a mang mi khempeuhte in Pasian’ tate ahi uh hi.
Note in kihtak kikkik nading sila’ lungsim na ngah kei uh hi. “Abba, Pa aw,” i cih mah bangin ta suahna lungsim na ngah uh hi.
Eite in Pasian’ tate i hi ci-in Kha Siangtho in eite lungsim tawh teci a pang khawm hi.
Tate i hih leh, gamhluahte i hi hi. Khazih tawh kibangin vangliatna ngah nadingin amah tawh gimna thuak khawm leng, amah tawh gamluah khawm ding i hi hi.
Eite tungah hong kilang ding vangliatna ka ngaihsut ciangin, tu laitak i thuak gimnate ngaihsut tham ka sa kei hi.
A kipiangsak nate in Pasian’ tate a kilat ding lamenin, lawp pha-in a ngak uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, a kipiangsak nate in a kisia gam lam, amau ut bangin zui ahi kei uh hi.

Pasian’ tate’ vangliatna tawh kipawl khahkhiat nopsakna ahi, kisiatna hen gawpna panin kikhahkhia-in nopsakna ah a tum ding ci-in lamet nading thu pia a, a kisia thei gam lam a zuisakpa’ deihna bang bek a zui uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a kipiangsak nate khempeuh in tu dongin a tau uh a, gimna thuakin a om uh i thei hi.
Tua tham loin Kha Siangtho a kipatna gah a ngah eite in zong a tate za-ah koihna thu ahi, i pumpi gupkhiatna ngakin i pumpi sungah tau-in i om hi.
Eite in lametna hangin gupna i ngah hi. Ahih hangin lametna in i muhsa ahih leh, lamet nading a om kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a muhsate kua in a lamen nawn ding hiam?
I muh loh nate i lamet leh, tuate lungnemna tawh ngakin i om hi.

Tua mah bangin Kha Siangtho in i thahat lohnate hong huh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite in thunget ding a kilawm bangin thunget ding i thei kei hi. Kha Siangtho mah in muk tawh kipau thei lo tauna tawh, eite ading thu hong ngetsak hi.
Lungsim sung a zongpa in Kha Siangtho’ lungsim a thei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua Kha Siangtho in misiangthote ading Pasian’ deihna tawh kituakin thu a ngetsak hi.
Pasian a it mite ahi uh, a geelna banga a sap mite adingin na khempeuh in hoih nadingin a piang uh hi cih i thei hi.
Pasian’ Tapa in unau tampite lakah a upa bel a suah nadingin Pasian in nidang lai-a a theihkhol mite, a Tapa’ lim tawh kibang a suahsak nadingin, nidang lai-in a ciamteh khol hi.
Pasian in a ciamtehsa mite a sam hi. A sapsa mite zong a diksak hi. A diksak mite vangliatna a pia hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, hih thu hangin bang gen ding i hi hiam? Pasian in eite lamsang ah a om leh, kua in eite lang khatah a pang zo ding hiam?
Ama Tapa khat bek haza lo a, eite khempeuh ading a piapa in man ngen loin nate khempeuh ama Ta tawh hong pia khawm loin a om ding hiam?
Pasian’ teelsate kua in a mawhsak ding hiam? A diksakpa in Pasian ahi hi.
Mawhsakna thu a khenpa in kua ahi hiam? Sihna a thuak tham loin, sihna pan thokik a, Pasian’ ziat lamah omin, eite ading thu hong ngetsakpa in Khazih ahi hi.

Khazih hong itna tawh eite kua in hong kikhensak zo ding ahi hiam? Gimna, kahna, bawlsiatna, gilkialna, puan neih lohna, kihtakna, namsaute in Khazih hong itna tawh eite hong kikhensak thei ding hiam?
Lai Siangtho sungah: “Nangma tang dingin kote in sunthapai-in thahna ka thuak uh hi; Gawh dinga a kikoih tuu tawh kibangin mite in kote hong ciamteh uh hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.
Khen thei lo ding hi! Ei hong itpa hangin hih nate khempeuh tungah gualzo pente i hi hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, sihna ahi zongin, hin’na ahi zongin, vantungmite ahi zongin, ukna ahi zongin, tu lai taka omte ahi zongin, tu nung ciangin a om dingte ahi zongin,
a san’na ahi zongin, a niamna akipan a kipiangsaksa khat beek in i Topa Khazih Zeisu hanga i ngah Pasian hong itna tawh hong kikhensak zo kei ding hi ci-in man takin ka um hi.
